name: Space Love!
source:
A sci-fi comedy parody of what most people think of when they think of visual novels.

Features:
* Multiple endings!
* Real-time emotions!
* Not really!
* SPACE!!!!
* Possibility of robot love!

[Edited from [url=http://www.bardinelli.com/?p=3012]official site[/url]]
translation:
一部科幻喜劇，惡搞大多數人對視覺小說的想像。

遊戲特色：
* 多重結局！
* 即時情緒！
* 才怪！
* 太空！！！！
* 機器人戀愛的可能性！

［改編自[url=http://www.bardinelli.com/?p=3012]官方網站[/url]］
